AccountIdentityAdoptRequest.description:
The identity to adopt, an empty object creates a new self-controlled DID. The body is required
so a cross-site form post cannot adopt an identity.

AccountIdentityExport.description:
The identity of an account with the credentials it holds, to move it to another account or node.
It contains private keys and must be protected.

type.description: The type of the file, checked first when it is imported.

credentials.description: The verifiable credentials held by the account, JSON credential objects with an embedded proof.

AccountIdentityImportResult.description: The result of importing an identity into an account.

credentialsSkipped.description:
The number of credentials left out, as they did not verify, were revoked or were not issued
to the identity.

organizations.description: The registered organizations the account became a member of through its credentials.

AccountOrganizationCreate.description: The details of an organization the signed in account creates for itself.

publicData.description: The paths of the data that is public, such as profile.name or logo.

organization.description: The DID of the organization, absent while there is none or a request is pending.

requests.description: The latest request to each organization, pending or answered, the latest changed first.

AccountProfileExport.description:
The account data of an account, other than its identity, organizations, credentials and node
migration records, which move with the identity export.

type.description: The type of the file, checked first when it is imported.

items.description: The items in the order they were created.

AccountProfileExportItem.description: An item of account data in a profile export.

data.description: The value of the item, a JSON object.

isDefault.description: True when the item is used first for its type.

dateCreated.description: When the item was created, for information, an imported item is created anew.

AccountProfileImportResult.description: The result of importing account data, which replaces the items of the types it may hold.

itemsImported.description: The number of items created from the import.

itemsRemoved.description: The number of existing items removed.

skippedTypes.description:
The types whose items in the import were left out, as the account holds a read only item of
the type or the item was read only.

AccountPublicDataGetResponse.description: The public JSON-LD objects, empty when nothing is public.

adminOnly.description: True when only admins may see and change the item, only present in admin responses.

dateCreated.description: When the item was created, in ISO date format.

dateModified.description: When the item was last modified, in ISO date format.

message.description: The message for the error as an i18n key.

properties.description: Any additional information for the error.

stack.description: The stack trace for the error.

documentSignature.description:

only for connectors which sign their stored documents.

keys.description: The private keys for the identity.

IdentityExportAccount.description: The wallet account secrets of a self-controlled identity held in an identity export.

seed.description: The seed derived from the mnemonic in base64 format.

publicKey.description: The public key in base64 format.

are not its members or admins, and in a search, where the name is always included.

isAdmin.description: True when the signed in caller is an org admin of the organization.

dateCreated.description: When the organization was created, in ISO date format.

dateModified.description: When the organization was last modified, in ISO date format.

identity.description: The DID of an existing organization to register, a node controlled DID is created when omitted.

publicData.description: The paths of the data that is public, such as profile.name or logo.

nextRevocationIndex.description:
The revocation index to give the next membership credential the organization issues, so an
import never gives a credential an index already used.

email.description: The e-mail address from the profile of the member, when it has one.

name.description: The name from the profile of the member, when it has one.

isAdmin.description: True when the member is an org admin of the organization.

cursor.description: The cursor to retrieve the next page, if any.

every storage.
